records.name: bridge_owner_submission_production_rollout_test
statements:
-- Production promotion of the tested Bridge owner-submission and archive lifecycle.

-- This additive migration consolidates the validated Testing candidates into one Production release migration.

-- It does not alter title metadata, assets, rights declarations, payments, or publication records.

alter table public.bridge_title_owner_submissions
  drop constraint if exists bridge_title_owner_submissions_submission_status_check;

alter table public.bridge_title_owner_submissions
  add constraint bridge_title_owner_submissions_submission_status_check
  check (submission_status in ('DRAFT', 'SUBMITTED', 'NEEDS_CORRECTION', 'ACCEPTED_INTAKE'));

-- Story / Concept keeps editorial, legal and buyer-curation statuses independent.
alter table public.bridge_story_concept_submissions
  add column if not exists owner_submission_status text not null default 'DRAFT';

create index if not exists bridge_story_concept_owner_submission_queue_idx
  on public.bridge_story_concept_submissions (owner_submission_status, created_at);

-- Append-only lifecycle evidence shared by both canonical submission types.
create table if not exists public.bridge_owner_submission_events (
  id bigserial primary key,
  title_id text not null references public.bridge_titles(id) on delete restrict,
  submission_kind text not null
    check (submission_kind in ('finished_film', 'story_concept')),
  action text not null
    check (action in ('SUBMITTED', 'RESUBMITTED', 'ACCEPTED_INTAKE', 'REQUEST_CHANGES')),
  from_status text,
  to_status text not null
    check (to_status in ('DRAFT', 'SUBMITTED', 'NEEDS_CORRECTION', 'ACCEPTED_INTAKE')),
  actor_user_id text not null references public.bridge_profiles(user_id),
  reason text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint bridge_owner_submission_events_reason_check
    check (reason is null or length(reason) <= 2000)
);

create index if not exists bridge_owner_submission_events_title_created_idx
  on public.bridge_owner_submission_events (title_id, created_at desc);

alter table public.bridge_owner_submission_events enable row level security;
revoke all on table public.bridge_owner_submission_events from public, anon, authenticated;
grant all on table public.bridge_owner_submission_events to postgres, service_role;

-- Prevent accidental history rewrites/deletes, including by ordinary server paths.
create or replace function public.bridge_reject_owner_submission_event_mutation()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $function$
begin
  raise exception 'Owner submission history is append-only';
end;
$function$;

revoke all on function public.bridge_reject_owner_submission_event_mutation() from public, anon, authenticated;

drop trigger if exists bridge_owner_submission_events_immutable on public.bridge_owner_submission_events;
create trigger bridge_owner_submission_events_immutable
before update or delete on public.bridge_owner_submission_events
for each row execute function public.bridge_reject_owner_submission_event_mutation();

GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON SEQUENCE public.bridge_owner_submission_events_id_seq TO postgres, service_role;

alter table public.bridge_titles
  add column if not exists archived_at timestamptz,
  add column if not exists archived_by text,
  add column if not exists archive_reason text,
  add column if not exists previous_status text;

-- Replace the earlier weaker archive-state check from the lifecycle repair.
-- NOT VALID avoids rewriting legacy rows while enforcing the strict DRAFT-only
-- archive invariant on every new or updated row.
alter table public.bridge_titles
  drop constraint if exists bridge_titles_archive_state_check;
alter table public.bridge_titles
  add constraint bridge_titles_archive_state_check
  check (
    (archived_at is null and archived_by is null and archive_reason is null and previous_status is null)
    or (archived_at is not null and archived_by is not null
        and length(btrim(archive_reason)) between 3 and 2000
        and previous_status = 'DRAFT')
  ) not valid;

create index if not exists bridge_titles_active_owner_updated_idx
  on public.bridge_titles(owner_user_id, updated_at desc)
  where archived_at is null;
create index if not exists bridge_titles_archived_owner_updated_idx
  on public.bridge_titles(owner_user_id, archived_at desc)
  where archived_at is not null;

create table if not exists public.bridge_title_archive_events (
  id bigserial primary key,
  title_id text not null references public.bridge_titles(id) on delete restrict,
  action text not null check (action in ('ARCHIVED','RESTORED')),
  actor_user_id text not null references public.bridge_profiles(user_id),
  actor_role text not null,
  organization_id uuid,
  previous_state jsonb not null,
  new_state jsonb not null,
  reason text not null check (length(btrim(reason)) between 3 and 2000),
  request_id text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists bridge_title_archive_events_title_created_idx
  on public.bridge_title_archive_events(title_id, created_at desc);
alter table public.bridge_title_archive_events enable row level security;
revoke all on table public.bridge_title_archive_events from public, anon, authenticated;
grant select, insert on table public.bridge_title_archive_events to service_role;
grant usage, select on sequence public.bridge_title_archive_events_id_seq to service_role;

create or replace function public.bridge_reject_title_archive_event_mutation()
returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path=public,pg_temp as $$
begin
  raise exception 'Title archive event ledger is append-only';
end $$;
revoke all on function public.bridge_reject_title_archive_event_mutation() from public, anon, authenticated;
drop trigger if exists bridge_title_archive_events_immutable on public.bridge_title_archive_events;
create trigger bridge_title_archive_events_immutable
before update or delete on public.bridge_title_archive_events
for each row execute function public.bridge_reject_title_archive_event_mutation();

create or replace function public.bridge_title_archive_dependency_blockers(p_title_id text)
returns text[]
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, bridge_private
as $$
declare
  item record;
  has_reference boolean;
  blockers text[] := array[]::text[];
  required_table text;
  required_tables text[] := array[
    'public.bridge_titles',
    'public.bridge_profiles',
    'public.bridge_organization_memberships',
    'public.bridge_audit_logs',
    'public.bridge_assets',
    'public.bridge_asset_versions',
    'public.bridge_buyer_title_access',
    'public.bridge_delivery_jobs',
    'public.bridge_destination_packages',
    'public.bridge_dit_ingest_sessions',
    'public.bridge_financial_ledger',
    'public.bridge_language_rights',
    'public.bridge_legal_cases',
    'public.bridge_license_packages',
    'public.bridge_loop_publications',
    'public.bridge_package_entitlements',
    'public.bridge_production_assets',
    'public.bridge_qc_cases',
    'public.bridge_rights_grants',
    'public.bridge_service_orders',
    'public.bridge_service_quotes',
    'public.bridge_service_settlement_rules',
    'public.bridge_story_concept_submissions',
    'public.bridge_title_document_links',
    'public.bridge_title_events',
    'public.bridge_title_gate_certifications',
    'public.bridge_title_owner_submissions',
    'public.bridge_title_submission_intake',
    'public.loop_titles',
    'public.streamvista_legacy_links',
    'public.bridge_title_archive_events'
  ];
begin
  if p_title_id is null or length(btrim(p_title_id)) = 0 then
    return array['invalid:title_id'];
  end if;

  foreach required_table in array required_tables loop
    if to_regclass(required_table) is null then
      blockers := array_append(blockers, 'schema:' || required_table || ':missing');
    end if;
  end loop;
  if cardinality(blockers) > 0 then
    return blockers;
  end if;

  -- Validate the exact columns used by the archive lifecycle and dependency
  -- scan before dynamic SQL runs. Missing columns must block archival.
  for item in
    select * from (values
      ('public','bridge_titles','id'),('public','bridge_titles','slug'),
      ('public','bridge_titles','status'),('public','bridge_titles','owner_user_id'),
      ('public','bridge_titles','owner_account_type'),('public','bridge_titles','owner_organization_id'),
      ('public','bridge_titles','archived_at'),('public','bridge_titles','archived_by'),
      ('public','bridge_titles','archive_reason'),('public','bridge_titles','previous_status'),
      ('public','bridge_titles','master_key'),('public','bridge_titles','poster_key'),
      ('public','bridge_profiles','user_id'),
      ('public','bridge_organization_memberships','organization_id'),
      ('public','bridge_organization_memberships','user_id'),
      ('public','bridge_organization_memberships','status'),
      ('public','bridge_audit_logs','actor_user_id'),('public','bridge_audit_logs','action'),
      ('public','bridge_audit_logs','entity_type'),('public','bridge_audit_logs','entity_id'),
      ('public','bridge_audit_logs','metadata'),
      ('public','bridge_title_archive_events','title_id'),('public','bridge_title_archive_events','action'),
      ('public','bridge_title_archive_events','actor_user_id'),('public','bridge_title_archive_events','actor_role'),
      ('public','bridge_title_archive_events','organization_id'),('public','bridge_title_archive_events','previous_state'),
      ('public','bridge_title_archive_events','new_state'),('public','bridge_title_archive_events','reason'),
      ('public','bridge_assets','title_id'),('public','bridge_asset_versions','title_id'),
      ('public','bridge_buyer_title_access','title_id'),('public','bridge_delivery_jobs','title_id'),
      ('public','bridge_destination_packages','title_id'),('public','bridge_dit_ingest_sessions','title_id'),
      ('public','bridge_financial_ledger','title_id'),('public','bridge_language_rights','title_id'),
      ('public','bridge_legal_cases','title_id'),('public','bridge_license_packages','title_id'),
      ('public','bridge_loop_publications','bridge_title_id'),('public','bridge_package_entitlements','title_id'),
      ('public','bridge_production_assets','title_id'),('public','bridge_qc_cases','title_id'),
      ('public','bridge_rights_grants','title_id'),('public','bridge_service_orders','title_id'),
      ('public','bridge_service_quotes','title_id'),('public','bridge_service_settlement_rules','title_id'),
      ('public','bridge_story_concept_submissions','title_id'),('public','bridge_title_document_links','title_id'),
      ('public','bridge_title_events','title_id'),('public','bridge_title_events','from_status'),
      ('public','bridge_title_events','to_status'),('public','bridge_title_gate_certifications','title_id'),
      ('public','bridge_title_owner_submissions','title_id'),('public','bridge_title_submission_intake','title_id'),
      ('public','loop_titles','bridge_title_id'),('public','streamvista_legacy_links','bridge_title_id')
    ) as expected(schema_name,table_name,column_name)
  loop
    if not exists (
      select 1 from information_schema.columns c
      where c.table_schema=item.schema_name
        and c.table_name=item.table_name
        and c.column_name=item.column_name
    ) then
      blockers := array_append(
        blockers,
        'schema:' || item.schema_name || '.' || item.table_name || '.' || item.column_name || ':missing'
      );
    end if;
  end loop;
  if cardinality(blockers) > 0 then
    return blockers;
  end if;

  for item in
    select distinct ns.nspname as schema_name, cls.relname as table_name,
           att.attname as column_name
    from pg_class cls
    join pg_namespace ns on ns.oid=cls.relnamespace
    join pg_attribute att on att.attrelid=cls.oid
    where ns.nspname in ('public','bridge_private')
      and cls.relkind in ('r','p')
      and att.attnum > 0 and not att.attisdropped
      and (
        att.attname in ('title_id','bridge_title_id')
        or exists (
          select 1 from pg_constraint fk
          where fk.contype='f' and fk.conrelid=cls.oid
            and att.attnum = any(fk.conkey)
            and fk.confrelid='public.bridge_titles'::regclass
        )
      )
  loop
    if item.schema_name='public' and item.table_name='bridge_title_archive_events' then
      continue;
    end if;

    if item.schema_name='public' and item.table_name='bridge_title_events'
       and item.column_name='title_id' then
      execute format(
        'select exists (select 1 from %I.%I where %I=$1 and not (from_status is null and to_status=''DRAFT''))',
        item.schema_name,item.table_name,item.column_name
      ) into has_reference using p_title_id;
    else
      execute format(
        'select exists (select 1 from %I.%I where %I=$1)',
        item.schema_name,item.table_name,item.column_name
      ) into has_reference using p_title_id;
    end if;

    if has_reference then
      blockers := array_append(blockers, item.schema_name || '.' || item.table_name || '.' || item.column_name);
    end if;
  end loop;
  return blockers;
end;
$$;
revoke all on function public.bridge_title_archive_dependency_blockers(text) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.bridge_title_archive_dependency_blockers(text) to service_role;

statements:
-- Resolve Loop media only from Bridge-verified asset provenance.
-- Applied to the isolated Testing project only. Production remains untouched.
create or replace function public.bridge_resolve_loop_asset(
  p_loop_title_id text,
  p_bridge_title_id text,
  p_asset_role text
)
returns table (
  loop_title_id text,
  bridge_title_id text,
  asset_role text,
  object_key text,
  checksum_sha256 text,
  storage_provider text,
  storage_bucket text,
  storage_region text,
  storage_endpoint text,
  asset_version_id text,
  storage_verified_at text
)
language sql
stable
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $function$
  select
    l.id::text,
    l.bridge_title_id,
    upper(p_asset_role),
    to_jsonb(a)->>'verified_object_key',
    coalesce(to_jsonb(a)->>'checksum_sha256', to_jsonb(a)->>'sha256'),
    to_jsonb(a)->>'storage_provider',
    to_jsonb(a)->>'storage_bucket',
    to_jsonb(a)->>'storage_region',
    to_jsonb(a)->>'storage_endpoint',
    to_jsonb(a)->>'asset_version_id',
    to_jsonb(a)->>'storage_verified_at'
  from public.loop_titles as l
  join public.bridge_loop_publications as p
    on p.loop_title_id::text = l.id::text
   and p.bridge_title_id = l.bridge_title_id
  join public.bridge_assets as a
    on a.title_id = l.bridge_title_id
  join public.bridge_asset_versions as av
    on av.id::text = to_jsonb(a)->>'asset_version_id'
   and av.title_id = l.bridge_title_id
  where l.id::text = p_loop_title_id
    and l.bridge_title_id = p_bridge_title_id
    and upper(coalesce(p.authorization_status, '')) = 'AUTHORIZED'
    and coalesce(to_jsonb(p)->>'destination', 'CRAYONS_LOOP') = 'CRAYONS_LOOP'
    and p.approved_at is not null
    and p.revoked_at is null
    and p.window_start is not null
    and p.window_end is not null
    and p.window_start <= now()
    and p.window_end > now()
    and p.territories @> array['WORLDWIDE']::text[]
    and exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(p.languages) as allowed(language)
      where upper(btrim(allowed.language)) = upper(btrim(coalesce(l.language, '')))
    )
    and p.exploitation_models @> array[upper(l.access_tier)]::text[]
    and upper(coalesce(to_jsonb(l)->>'status', '')) in ('APPROVED', 'PUBLISHED')
    and coalesce(
      nullif(to_jsonb(l)->>'listed', '')::boolean,
      nullif(to_jsonb(l)->>'is_listed', '')::boolean,
      false
    ) is true
    and coalesce(
      nullif(to_jsonb(l)->>'published', '')::boolean,
      nullif(to_jsonb(l)->>'is_published', '')::boolean,
      false
    ) is true
    and av.processing_state = 'PASSED'
    and (
      (upper(p_asset_role) = 'MASTER' and a.kind = 'master' and av.asset_group = 'VIDEO')
      or
      (upper(p_asset_role) = 'POSTER'
        and a.kind in ('poster', 'poster_horizontal', 'poster_vertical')
        and av.asset_group = 'ARTWORK')
      or
      (upper(p_asset_role) = 'TRAILER'
        and a.kind in ('technical', 'thumbnail')
        and av.asset_group = 'PROMO'
        and upper(av.asset_type) like '%TRAILER%')
    )
    and nullif(to_jsonb(a)->>'verified_object_key', '') is not null
    and nullif(to_jsonb(a)->>'storage_verified_at', '') is not null
    and nullif(coalesce(to_jsonb(a)->>'checksum_sha256', to_jsonb(a)->>'sha256'), '') is not null
    and nullif(to_jsonb(a)->>'storage_provider', '') is not null
    and nullif(to_jsonb(a)->>'storage_bucket', '') is not null
  order by a.created_at desc
  limit 1;
$function$;

revoke all on function public.bridge_resolve_loop_asset(text, text, text) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.bridge_resolve_loop_asset(text, text, text) to service_role;

create or replace function public.public_loop_catalog()
returns table(
 id text, bridge_title_id text, slug text, title text, synopsis text, description text,
 content_type text, language text, year integer, duration_minutes integer,
 maturity_rating text, director text, is_original boolean, original_badge text,
 status text, listed boolean, published boolean, featured boolean, access_tier text,
 tvod_rental_price numeric, poster_available boolean, backdrop_available boolean,
 trailer_available boolean
)
language sql
stable
set search_path = ''
as $$
 select
  l.id,
  l.bridge_title_id,
  l.slug,
  l.title,
  l.synopsis,
  null::text as description,
  'Film'::text as content_type,
  l.language,
  l.release_year as year,
  l.runtime_minutes as duration_minutes,
  l.age_rating as maturity_rating,
  null::text as director,
  false as is_original,
  null::text as original_badge,
  lower(l.status) as status,
  l.is_listed as listed,
  l.is_published as published,
  false as featured,
  l.access_tier,
  (l.price_paise::numeric / 100) as tvod_rental_price,
  (nullif(l.poster_url,'') is not null) as poster_available,
  (nullif(l.backdrop_url,'') is not null) as backdrop_available,
  (nullif(l.trailer_url,'') is not null) as trailer_available
from public.loop_titles l
join public.bridge_loop_publications p
  on p.loop_title_id::text=l.id::text
 and p.bridge_title_id=l.bridge_title_id
where lower(p.authorization_status)='authorized'
  and p.approved_at is not null
  and p.revoked_at is null
  and p.window_start is not null and p.window_end is not null
  and p.window_start <= now() and p.window_end > now()
  and p.territories @> ARRAY['WORLDWIDE']::text[]
  and p.languages @> ARRAY[l.language]::text[]
  and p.exploitation_models @> ARRAY[l.access_tier]::text[]
  and upper(coalesce(l.status,'')) in ('APPROVED','PUBLISHED')
  and l.is_listed is true and l.is_published is true
order by l.created_at desc;
$$;
